question.text: What activities does Chen Lu plan to teach his son at home when the weather is bad?

supporting_evidence.content: Chen Lu: Fang Qing, I plan to take my son to free parks or riversides for bike rides when the weather is nice, and I can also go for a run to exercise. When the weather is bad, we’ll stay at home, and I’ll teach him how to play chess or watch an old movie together. Since you nurses have fewer days off, it’s even more important to choose activities that are low-maintenance and easygoing.
